preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of flights m is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai < bi <= n for ai, bi in flights)
preconditions.description: Each flight is between two distinct cities ai and bi where 1 <= ai < bi <= n.
The number of flights listed is exactly m.

preconditions.expression: 1 in [ai for ai, _ in flights] and n in [bi for _, bi in flights]
preconditions.description: There is at least one flight starting from city 1 and one flight ending at city n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No' or (stdout.startswith('Yes') and len(stdout.splitlines()) == m + 1 and all(line in ['1', '2'] for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'No' or 'Yes' followed by m lines each containing either '1' or '2'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No' or all(trip_time == trip_times[0] for trip_time in trip_times)
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'No', all trips from city 1 to city n have the same total travel time.
